title: rbgrid_cmd action response (wrapper)
description: What the rbgrid_cmd action returns. Either a plain reply (the device reply in `data`) or part 0..n-1 of a reply over 4000 bytes (base64 in `b64`; reassemble, then parse = the device reply). Schema 1. Extra keys may appear and must be ignored.

ok.description: false = device error; the action itself then fails with the device message

type.description: device reply type (cmd_ack, units_config, series, price, ...)

bytes.description: size of the whole reassembled reply

b64.description: up to 3072 raw bytes of the reply
